title: Long-Term Hardship Hold Extensions — Programme Allowance by Debt Type
content:
For a long-term extension of a Long-Term Hardship Hold under Hardship and Protective Holds, the program allowance depends on the held account's debt type, as classified in the account's Placed Consumer Accounts record. The allowance is added once to the days the long-term extension adds.

## Programme schedule

| Debt type of the held account | Program allowance |
|---|---|
| Medical | 30 calendar days (medical program days) |
| Auto deficiency | 15 calendar days (installment program days) |
| Retail installment | 15 calendar days (installment program days) |
| Private student loan | 15 calendar days (installment program days) |
| Bank card, utility or telecom | Nothing |

## Notes

- Only the held account's debt type counts; the consumer's other placed accounts do not enter.
- The three installment-type debts share one figure, 15 calendar days.

**Example (hypothetical).** A long-term extension on a held private student loan account adds 15 calendar days on this ground; on a held telecom account it adds nothing.
